title: Global Director, Operations & Supply Chain - Data Center Solutions
text:
**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

The Global Director of Operations provides strategic and functional leadership for manufacturing operations across multiple sites and regions. This role develops and executes operational strategies to deliver world-class performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and customer satisfaction while supporting business growth and long-term competitiveness.

The Global Director leads and influences across Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Materials and Logistics, Capital and Capacity Management, and digital manufacturing. This leader drives operational excellence through the Eaton Business System, continuous improvement, integrated planning, technology enablement, and development of high-performing teams. 
 
**Essential Responsibilities:** 

* Develop and execute the global operations strategy in alignment with business objectives, annual profit plan commitments, growth priorities, and customer requirements.
* Provide strategic and functional leadership across global manufacturing operations to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead manufacturing capacity, utilization, capital investment, and footprint strategies to support current business requirements and future growth.
* Drive Integrated Operations across Manufacturing Excellence, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Materials and Logistics, Capital and Capacity Management, and SIOP/S&OE.
* Establish key performance indicators and operating rhythms to monitor operational and financial performance and drive accountability for results.
* Champion Environmental, Health and Safety and build a zero-incident culture with strong leadership and employee ownership.
* Drive a zero-defect culture through effective quality systems, disciplined root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement.
* Lead operational excellence through the Eaton Business System, lean management systems, standard work, and structured problem solving.
* Advance digital manufacturing, automation, analytics, and Industry 4.0 capabilities to improve productivity and competitiveness.
* Partner cross-functionally to support new product introductions, manufacturing readiness, product transitions, and strategic growth initiatives.
* Build organizational capability through talent assessment, succession planning, leadership development, and workforce planning.
* Lead organizational change and build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, engagement, continuous improvement, and customer expectations.
* Ensure compliance with environmental, health, safety, quality, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements.
* Demonstrate leadership consistent with the Eaton Culture Model and Eaton Code of Ethics.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Basic Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations/Manufacturing, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations, supply chain, operational excellence, engineering, quality, or related functions.
* Significant plant leadership and multi-site operations management experience.
* Experience leading complex operations within a large manufacturing organization.
* Demonstrated experience with manufacturing strategy, capacity planning, capital management, footprint optimization, and continuous improvement.
* Strong business and financial acumen with experience managing operational and financial performance.

**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* Experience leading geographically dispersed operations within a global manufacturing organization.
* Prior profit and loss responsibility.
* Experience with lean management systems, SIOP/S&OE, MRP, ERP, and quality management systems.
* Experience with advanced manufacturing, automation, digital manufacturing, and Industry 4.0 technologies.
* Demonstrated experience leading organizational transformation and developing senior operations talent.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

The application window for this position is anticipated to close on 12/31/2026

 

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

At Eaton, we strive to provide compensation and benefits that attract, engage, and retain the best talent. This includes competitive pay and a variety of benefit programs for eligible employees. The expected annual salary range for this role is $182000 - $266000 a year. This role is also eligible for a variable incentive program. *Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.*

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.

You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.

To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.

We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. Please note that specific programs and options available to an employee may depend on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.
